replies.author: Odd-Score2887
replies.body: Tried using Sol to create another game like this for several weeks but it took such a long time for it to get things right. Finally managed to get it to create pretty good looking assets for this style and made it create a skill based on that. It is now using that skill to create all the assets. Basically, its just creating images as references with that 2000's style RPG look and then it begins trying to build the assets based on those references. It takes several iterations and also I need to describe what I want and tell it to change stuff a lot. But after some time it will become basically what you wanted.

replies.author: TinyPeopleProject
replies.body: Lots of edge cases can cause Z fighting. Z fighting is best seen in a video/multiple frame analysis which AI does not really do today unprompted. It fixes Z fighting if you tell AI it is present or to look for it.

replies.author: C0mpass619

replies.author: Odd-Score2887
replies.body: My bad bro. So for characters I told it to make human anatomy realistic, no clipping, no weird faces or wrongly angled elbows etc. then it said itself that it has some kind of Godot add on/package whatever for human characters and I just approved that it could use that. However the animations are not great for instance, so needs several iterations to get it good. From my experience basically nothing is a one shot prompt that just works - you need to carefully describe what you want - show references as well and do many iterations. I’m going to focus on characters and animations today and will share if I want something that works really well

replies.author: monsterfurby
replies.body:
I kind of get it though. This looks cool, but so far, it's a video. It would be great to hear the vision for the game first, and what ideas OP is trying to realize. Yes, we got a gameplay trailer, but like with every game, it would be great to not just see the "what", but also the "why".

Then there's also the headlining of the tool over the project, which I get. Yeah, some reasonably impressive (other than the GenAI-standard UI) stuff can get made with AI assistants, but I also think a thread should either be "here's the project I can finally realize" or "discussion on the quality of Model X", not both conflated. Threads that focus on the project tend to get better received.
